subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth attention in these incident descriptions.

judge.implied_focus: Characterizing and triaging incidents by their nature (type, severity, likely root cause, and recurrence) to identify what warrants attention

per_column.name: incident_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the substantive nature of each incident from its description -- a core facet of what the incident is about.

per_column.name: severity_indicator
per_column.rationale: Captures impact level (outage vs degraded vs blocked access), directly relevant to prioritizing attention.

per_column.name: root_cause_hint
per_column.rationale: Infers likely causal layer, adding an explanatory facet to the incident characterization.

per_column.name: temporal_recurrence
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes recurring vs isolated issues, a strong signal for what is worth attention.

per_column.name: assignment_consistency
per_column.rationale: A process/ops quality flag about assignment, orthogonal to characterizing the incident content itself.

per_column.name: assigned_to_technician
per_column.rationale: Largely restates the existing assigned_to field; a routing attribute, not a facet of incident nature.

per_column.name: caller_category
per_column.rationale: Describes who reported the incident (human vs automation), tangential to the incident's substance and severity.

judge.rationale: A clear plurality of columns (incident_type, severity_indicator, root_cause_hint, temporal_recurrence) coherently centre on a single inferable focus: characterizing incidents by their nature and impact to surface what deserves attention. These form a genuine multi-facet analytical structure (type / severity / cause / recurrence) at a useful granularity, and the focus is highly actionable for triage. However, coherence is diluted by three columns that drift onto adjacent, non-incident-nature themes (process assignment quality, technician identity that duplicates existing data, and caller provenance). This scatter across ops-hygiene and routing dimensions keeps the set from being a tightly unified focus, and one column is largely a restatement of an existing field, so structure and coherence fall short of full marks.
